verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions PCI DSS scope. It also never documents that card data entered in Adyen's checkout components bypasses the merchant's servers. The only tokenization and encrypted-payment references are for agentic-commerce flows (agent platforms, Google UCP), which is a different story and does not transfer to general merchant PCI scope reduction.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my systems out of most of PCI DSS scope because card data is tokenized and never touches my servers
